verdict.rationale: The IVS user guide documents that IVS emits stream and stage events (for example, a publisher connecting and being recorded to S3). You can create rules that trigger on these events through Amazon EventBridge, so event-driven automation exists, but the rule engine and actions run in a separate AWS service rather than natively in IVS. missing for 10: native rule definition within IVS itself, documentation of the available actions/targets and full event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can create a rule that triggers on an event emitted by Amazon IVS.
You can use Amazon EventBridge to monitor your Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) streams.
A publisher has connected to the stage and is being recorded to S3.
